annotation.bound_parties_text: The working paper binds no one; it only encourages High Contracting Parties to consider ways to address bias in a future normative framework on autonomous weapons.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: encourages all High Contracting Parties to consider ways to address bias in a future normative framework on autonomous weapons.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This paper sets out issues related to bias in Autonomous Weapons, as discussed in the framework of the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW)
